title: Checking divided-power multiplication and iteration on ideal generators
statement:
Let $C$ be a commutative ring, $J\subseteq C$ an ideal, and $S\subseteq J$ a set generating $J$ as an ideal. Let $\delta_n:J\to J$ for $n\geq1$, and put $\delta_0(z)=1\in C$. Assume for all $z,w\in J$, $c\in C$, and $n\geq1$ that $\delta_1(z)=z$, $\delta_n(cz)=c^n\delta_n(z)$ and $\delta_n(z+w)=\sum_{i=0}^n\delta_i(z)\delta_{n-i}(w)$. Assume for every $s\in S$ and positive integers $n,m$ that
$$\delta_n(s)\delta_m(s)=\binom{n+m}{n}\delta_{n+m}(s),\qquad\delta_n(\delta_m(s))=\frac{(nm)!}{n!(m!)^n}\delta_{nm}(s).$$
Then these last two identities hold for every $z\in J$, and $\delta$ is an ordinary divided-power structure on $J$ [def-sfb-ordinary-divided-power-structure]. The factorial quotient is an integer coefficient. The generating set need not be finite and may be empty when $J=0$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-pd-check-generators] with its ring $A=C$, ideal $I=J$, generating set the given $S$, and maps $g_n=\delta_n$. Its three globally assumed identities are exactly the identity, scalar homogeneity and addition hypotheses here, including $g_0=\delta_0=1$. Its two generator identities have the same positive indices and the same integer coefficients as ours. Thus the given maps $\delta_n$ form an ordinary divided-power structure on $J$. This application imposes neither finiteness nor nonemptiness on $S$, and does not invert any integer.

source.place: Tag 07GP (lemma-check-on-generators), statement; reuse of the existing DAG statement.

proof.text: Unpack [def-sfb-ordinary-divided-power-structure] for the structure on the same maps obtained in step 1: its fourth and fifth displayed axioms give $\delta_n(z)\delta_m(z)=\binom{n+m}{n}\delta_{n+m}(z)$ and $\delta_n(\delta_m(z))=((nm)!/(n!(m!)^n))\delta_{nm}(z)$ for every $z\in J$ and positive $n,m$. These are precisely the two requested identities. If $S$ is empty then $J=0$ because $S$ generates $J$; scalar homogeneity with $c=0$ gives $\delta_n(0)=0$ for $n>0$, so the same conclusion includes the zero ideal.

lean.statement: theorem generator_criterion {C : Type u} [CommRing C] (J : Ideal C) (S : Set J) (hS : Ideal.span (Subtype.val '' S) = J) (δ : ℕ → J → C) (hzero : ∀ z : J, δ 0 z = 1) (hmem : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ z : J, δ n z ∈ J) (hone : ∀ z : J, δ 1 z = (z : C)) (hscalar : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (c : C) (z : J), δ n (c • z) = c ^ n * δ n z) (hadd : ∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ z w : J, δ n (z + w) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), δ i z * δ (n - i) w) (hmul : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ (n m : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < m → δ n s * δ m s = (Nat.choose (n + m) n : C) * δ (n + m) s) (hcomp : ∀ s ∈ S, ∀ (n m : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ hm : 0 < m, δ n ⟨δ m s, hmem m hm s⟩ = (((n * m).factorial / (n.factorial * m.factorial ^ n) : ℕ) : C) * δ (n * m) s) : (∀ (z : J) (n m : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < m → δ n z * δ m z = (Nat.choose (n + m) n : C) * δ (n + m) z) ∧ (∀ (z : J) (n m : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ hm : 0 < m, δ n ⟨δ m z, hmem m hm z⟩ = (((n * m).factorial / (n.factorial * m.factorial ^ n) : ℕ) : C) * δ (n * m) z) ∧ ∃ γ : DividedPowers J, ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : J), γ.dpow n z = δ n z

reviewed_lean.note: Lean DividedPowers.generator_criterion matches node and Stacks 07GP clause by clause: ideal span of S : Set J, δ : ℕ → J → C with hmem/hzero/hone/hscalar/hadd for n>0, generator hmul/hcomp for positive n,m with ℕ-cast coefficients ((n*m)!/(n!(m!)^n) = uniformBell n m, Mathlib dpow_comp order). Conclusion: both identities for all z, and ∃ γ : DividedPowers J with γ.dpow n z = δ n z (γ pinned to δ). Edge cases checked: empty S (J=0), infinite S, zero ring, n or m = 1, any characteristic, single universe u.
